chart.description: average and peak measured over dashboard time window
chart.name: Nodes summary
chart.programText:
A = data('ray_node_cpu_utilization', rollup='latest').sum(by=['SessionName', 'ip']).publish(label='A')
B = data('ray_node_cpu_count').sum(by=['SessionName', 'ip']).publish(label='B')
C = ((A*0.01)*B).publish(label='C', enable=False)
F = data('ray_node_cpu_utilization', rollup='max').sum(by=['SessionName', 'ip']).max(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='F', enable=False)
G = data('ray_node_cpu_utilization', rollup='average').sum(by=['SessionName', 'ip']).publish(label='G')
H = data('ray_node_mem_used', rollup='latest').sum(by=['SessionName', 'ip']).publish(label='H', enable=False)
I = data('ray_node_mem_total', rollup='latest').sum(by=['SessionName', 'ip']).publish(label='I')
J = (H/I*100).publish(label='J', enable=False)
K = data('ray_node_mem_used', rollup='max').sum(by=['SessionName', 'ip']).max(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='K', enable=False)
L = (K/I*100).publish(label='L')
M = data('ray_node_mem_used', rollup='average').sum(by=['SessionName', 'ip']).mean(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='M', enable=False)
N = (M/I*100).publish(label='N', enable=False)
O = data('ray_node_gpus_available').sum(by=['SessionName', 'ip']).publish(label='O')
P = data('ray_node_gpus_utilization', rollup='latest').sum(by=['SessionName', 'ip']).publish(label='P', enable=False)
Q = (P/O).publish(label='Q', enable=False)
R = data('ray_node_gpus_utilization', rollup='max').sum(by=['SessionName', 'ip']).max(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='R', enable=False)
S = (R/O).publish(label='S', enable=False)
V = data('ray_node_gram_used', rollup='latest').sum(by=['SessionName', 'ip']).publish(label='V', enable=False)
W = data('ray_node_gram_available', rollup='latest').sum(by=['SessionName', 'ip']).publish(label='W', enable=False)
X = (V+W).publish(label='X', enable=False)
Y = (V/X*100).publish(label='Y', enable=False)
AG = data('ray_object_store_used_memory').sum(by=['SessionName']).publish(label='AG', enable=False)
AH = data('ray_object_store_available_memory').sum(by=['SessionName']).publish(label='AH', enable=False)
AL = (AJ+AK).publish(label='AL')
AI = (((AG+V)-V)/(AG+AH)*100).publish(label='AI', enable=False)
AJ = ((AG+V)-V).publish(label='AJ', enable=False)
AK = ((AH+V)-V).publish(label='AK', enable=False)
AN = (((AM+V)-V)/AL*100).publish(label='AN')
AP = (((AO+V)-V)/AL*100).publish(label='AP', enable=False)
AM = data('ray_object_store_used_memory', rollup='max').sum(by=['SessionName']).max(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='AM', enable=False)
AO = data('ray_object_store_used_memory', rollup='average').sum(by=['SessionName']).mean(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='AO', enable=False)

chart.name: Total resources allocated (active nodes)
chart.programText:
A = data('ray_resources', filter=filter('State', 'USED')).dimensions(renames={"Session Name": "SessionName","Node Address":"NodeAddress"}).sum(by=['Session Name', 'Node Address']).max(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).publish(label='A')
B = data('ray_resources', filter=filter('State', 'AVAILABLE')).dimensions(renames={"Session Name": "SessionName","Node Address":"NodeAddress"}).sum(by=['Session Name', 'Node Address']).above(0).publish(label='B')
C = data('ray_resources').dimensions(renames={"Session Name": "SessionName","Node Address":"NodeAddress"}).sum(by=['Session Name', 'Node Address']).above(0).publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (A/C*100).publish(label='D')

chart.programText:
A = data('ray_serve_deployment_replica_healthy', rollup='max').dimensions(renames={"Session Name": "SessionName","Application":"application"}).above(1, inclusive=True).count(by=['Application', 'Session Name', 'deployment', 'replica']).sum(by=['Application', 'Session Name']).publish(label='A')
